required_for_match: same regulatory concept and failure boundary
candidate evidence collectively covers every material required citation
candidate applicability is not broader than the planned concept
matching_rules.split_candidates: May collectively recover one planned concept; report the split and count duplicate or unsupported coverage separately.
matching_rules.merged_candidates: May recover multiple planned concepts only when each concept and its citations remain independently reviewable; report the merge explicitly.
matching_rules.duplicate_rule: A second candidate testing the same concept, applicability, and failure boundary is a duplicate unless it supplies a documented structural split.
matching_rules.ambiguous_match: Record for review; do not choose the most favorable mapping.

metrics.precision: candidate page proposals matched to at least one planned concept divided by all candidate page proposals
